module: Module 5: Partial Fills, Asymmetric Rejections & Slippage
title: Single Sub-Account Insufficient Margin Rejection (Partial Group Rejection)
precondition: Master sends 10-account block; Sub-account #8 has insufficient free margin.
steps: 1. Broker risk engine evaluates margin for all 10 accounts.
expected_result: Sub-account #8 order rejected with 'Insufficient Margin'; remaining 9 sub-accounts fill successfully; Master notified.
